project_description: Converge Go-LIP's merged request-attempt and receive-terminal refactors into one lifecycle-correct runtime boundary. Ensure every backend attempt remains under one owner from first resource acquisition through readiness, publication, replacement, and exactly-once terminal settlement; prohibit fallible attempt-local setup after publication; make initial and replacement publication linearizable with Close; reduce parallel arms through typed immutable outcomes rather than shared recovery mutation; and make frozen typed turn facts authoritative over caller context. Preserve selector, streaming, B2BUA, authority, billing, secure-session, extension, observer, interleaved-reasoning, protocol, and plugin semantics. Do not change public APIs, configuration grammar, provider adapters, billing/security domains, or introduce a generic workflow, actor, resource-ledger, or dependency-injection framework.
